name: hms-system
description: MedCore HMS - clinic website with patient booking plus a staff management system

scripts.setup: npm --workspace hms-backend run db:migrate && npm --workspace hms-backend run db:seed
scripts.build: npm --workspace hms-backend run build && npm --workspace hms-frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace hms-backend run typecheck && npm --workspace hms-frontend exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.db:reset: npm --workspace hms-backend run db:migrate && npm --workspace hms-backend run db:seed
